entries.subject: ESO archive access for the ESO 3.6-metre telescope
entries.finding: The ESO archive holds this telescope's data. Its TAP service answered anonymously on 2026-09-17 (capabilities 200), and the same service, the calselector trees, the header service and the data portal already drive this repository's VLTI calibrations. Raw frames outside their proprietary period download without an account.
entries.revisitWhen: A body or star in this repository needs data from this facility.

entries.subject: Proprietary period, licence and credit
entries.finding: Public ESO archive data are distributed under CC BY 4.0, and a cast body credits ESO with the programme identifier of its frames. The proprietary period for this telescope's programmes was not checked.
entries.revisitWhen: This facility's data are used, or its terms are needed to publish a derived product.

entries.subject: Reduction software for this facility
entries.finding: The ESO pipelines for this telescope's instruments are public kits; only the VLTI kits (PIONIER, AMBER, GRAVITY, MATISSE) are pinned and built here.
entries.revisitWhen: Raw data from this facility are reduced here.
